main_text.p: duratio Æternitati coæva est, nam Sanctitatē suam Deus ab æterno intuitus fuit; Quæque desituris Scientiis aliis æternùm duratura est; Charitas enim nunquam excidet, sed Prophetiæ evanescent, & Linguæ cessabunt & cognitio definet.

Itaq; non autumo mihi opus fore rationibus reddendis, cur publice tractandā suscEperim: Si enim sciri eam omnium interest, cura ipsius nemini vitio verti potest: Si Medicinam promiscue facere communi propensioni in rem humanam transcribimus, quidni hujus potius curam communem esse sinamus, quæ ingratos, avaros, vino deditos, ambitiosos tam propitia aspicit, quā ægros suos Medicina: Quæ laxatis compedibus rem humanam aqvam trahere aspicit & occurrit, aliam excludit undam, aliam egerit, manifesta foramina præcludit, latentibus & ex occulto sententiam ducentibus labore continuo resistit: Breviter curat, ut homo idem perstet, ac ne ruat intereatve cavet.
At ILLUSTRITUDINI VESTRÆ cur operam hanc delegaverim, dicendum omnino erit.

page.notes: Printed text runs to the foot; the catchword "Virtu-" is at the right below the last line. The word "suscEperim" is as printed ("suscepērim" in modern form); the scan shows "fuscé-perim", read here as "suscēperim" with the hyphen at line end; reading uncertain at the line join. Also "Itaq;" and "tractandā" as printed. Some letters are blurred by the scan.
